note: Lynx Dash tuning. questions = pairwise questions per round (each after segmentMs of ACTIVE running). Hand-set for iteration 1; recalibrate from logs/human runner logs.

focus.note: Focus assessment weights (penalty per opportunity). obstacle = running into a cactus (largest); projectile = hit by a crow (crows are the projectile class: they fly in 8% faster than the ground); coin = missed coin (smallest). focus = 100*(1 - sum(w*rate)/sum(w)).
